documents.title: Company Overview & Mission
documents.summary: Velvora Solutions’ mission is to build accessible, precision-driven digital solutions uniting advanced technology with human craftsmanship to deliver uncompromising quality for global organizations.
documents.content:
Velvora Solutions Company Overview:
Mission: To build accessible, precision-driven digital solutions uniting advanced technology with human dedication to deliver uncompromising quality for global organizations.
Vision: To empower publishers, academic institutions, and enterprises worldwide with universal digital accessibility, seamless publishing transformations, and resilient software architectures.
Core Values:
1. Universal Inclusion: Making digital content usable by everyone, conforming to WCAG 2.2 and PDF/UA.
2. Technical Craftsmanship: Extreme precision in XML schemas, InDesign composition, LaTeX mathematics, and software engineering.
3. Integrity & Confidentiality: Strict data privacy, non-disclosure, and enterprise information security.
4. Client-Centric Innovation: Practical AI workflows and agile collaboration that cut turnarounds and scale output.
Quality Assurance: Dual-layer verification combining automated validators (Schematron, EPUBCheck, axe) with rigorous human expert reviews (JAWS, NVDA, screen-reader testing).

documents.title: ePublishing Services
documents.summary: Conversion, formatting, and multi-format delivery of books and journals in EPUB 2/3, PDF, and web formats by Velvora Solutions.
documents.content:
ePublishing Services (ePublishing Services: From Manuscript to Every Device)
Overview: Readers expect content on phones, tablets, e-readers, and the web. We prepare your content for all of them. Our ePublishing team converts and formats print and digital files into clean, standards-compliant outputs that work across platforms and retailers.
What We Offer:
  - EPUB 2 and EPUB 3 Creation: Reflowable and fixed-layout EPUBs for books, journals, and educational titles.
  - Print-to-Digital Conversion: Scanned or print-ready files converted into editable, structured digital formats.
  - PDF Production: Print-ready and interactive PDFs, including bookmarks, hyperlinks, and metadata.
  - Format Conversion: Word, InDesign, XML, and PDF to EPUB, HTML, or other formats.
  - Metadata and Packaging: Retailer-ready packaging for Kindle, Apple Books, Google Play Books, Kobo, and others.
  - Quality Validation: EPUBCheck validation plus manual device testing.
Our Process:
  - 1. Analyze: We review your source files, requirements, and target platforms.
  - 2. Plan: We agree on specifications, style rules, and timelines.
  - 3. Produce: Our team converts and formats your content.
  - 4. Validate: Automated and manual quality checks.
  - 5. Deliver: Final files, delivered on time with a quality report.
Target Audience / Who It's For:
Book publishers, journal publishers, educational publishers, authors, and corporate content teams.

documents.title: XML Services
documents.summary: Structured XML creation, conversion (JATS, BITS, DITA, DocBook), and workflows that make your content reusable, searchable, and future-ready.
documents.content:
XML Services (XML Services: Structured Content That Lasts)
Overview: Well-structured XML is the foundation of efficient publishing. It lets you create content once and publish it many times, across print, web, EPUB, and beyond. Velvora's XML specialists build and convert content to industry-standard structures, so your content stays consistent, searchable, and easy to maintain.
What We Offer:
  - XML Conversion: Word, PDF, and InDesign files converted to XML.
  - Industry DTDs and Schemas: JATS (journals), BITS (books), DITA, DocBook, TEI, and custom DTDs or schemas.
  - XML Tagging and Markup: Detailed, accurate structural and semantic tagging.
  - XML Quality Assurance: Validation against DTD or schema, plus manual review.
  - XML-First Workflow Setup: Help planning and implementing XML-based publishing workflows.
  - Output Transformation: XML to HTML, EPUB, PDF, and other formats using XSLT.
Our Process:

Target Audience / Who It's For:
Publishers, universities, enterprises, and content creators.

documents.title: Digital Accessibility
documents.summary: Complete digital accessibility audits, remediation and creation for EPUB 2/3, web, PDF, Word, PowerPoint, and Excel conforming to WCAG 2.2, PDF/UA, and Section 508.
documents.content:
Digital Accessibility (Digital Accessibility Services: Content Everyone Can Use)
Overview: More than a billion people worldwide live with some form of disability. Inaccessible content shuts them out, and it can expose organizations to legal and reputational risk. Velvora provides complete accessibility services, including audits, remediation, and new accessible content creation, across all major formats. Our specialists test with real assistive technologies such as JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver, and TalkBack, not just automated tools.
What We Offer:

Our Process:
  - 1. Assess: We review your files and goals, and agree on the standard to meet.
  - 2. Audit: Automated and manual testing, with a clear report of issues.
  - 3. Remediate: Our specialists fix issues at the source whenever possible.
  - 4. Verify: Testing with assistive technologies.
  - 5. Certify and Report: Delivery of fixed files with an accessibility compliance report.
  - 6. Train and Support: Optional training and ongoing support for your team.
Target Audience / Who It's For:
Publishers, universities, enterprises, and content creators.

documents.title: Typesetting and Design
documents.summary: Professional typesetting, page layout, and design for books, journals, and reports. Print-ready and digital-ready files from Velvora Solutions.
documents.content:
Typesetting and Design (Typesetting and Design: Pages That Look Good and Work Everywhere)
Overview: Good design helps readers focus on your content. Velvora's typesetting team turns manuscripts into polished, consistent, publication-ready pages. We work with your style guides and house templates, and we build files that can be reused for print, PDF, EPUB, and web, so you do not pay twice for the same content.
What We Offer:
  - Book Typesetting: Fiction, non-fiction, textbooks, reference works, and academic monographs.
  - Journal Typesetting: Article composition to your journal template, including proofs and corrections.
  - Page Layout and Composition: Layout in Adobe InDesign, LaTeX, and other professional tools.
  - Template Design: Custom, reusable templates for books, journals, and reports.
  - Cover and Jacket Design: Covers that match your brand and your readers.
  - Figures, Charts and Illustrations: Redrawing, cleaning, and creating clear, consistent artwork.
  - Tables and Complex Layouts: Accurate setting of multi-column, rotated, and data-heavy tables.
  - Author and Editor Proof Cycles: Managed proofing with tracked corrections and version control.
  - Print-Ready Files: PDF/X files with correct bleed, colour profiles, and fonts for printers.
  - Tagged and Accessible Output: Layouts built so accessible PDF and EPUB files can be produced from the same source.
Our Process:
  - 1. Brief: We review your style guide, templates, and requirements.
  - 2. Sample Pages: We set a few pages for your approval before full production.
  - 3. Composition: Full typesetting with consistent styles throughout.
  - 4. Proofing: First proofs, corrections, and second proofs.
  - 5. Final Files: Print-ready PDF, source files, and digital outputs.
Target Audience / Who It's For:
Book publishers, university presses, scholarly journals, societies, authors, and corporate communications teams.

documents.title: Math and Equation Typesetting
documents.summary: Accurate math and equation typesetting in LaTeX and MathML for STEM books and journals, including accessible math for EPUB, PDF, and web.
documents.content:
Math and Equation Typesetting (Math and Equation Typesetting: Precision for STEM Content)
Overview: Mathematical content demands accuracy. A single misplaced symbol can change the meaning of an equation. Velvora's math specialists typeset, convert, and validate equations for books, journals, and course material, and make sure math is accessible to readers who use screen readers and Braille displays.
What We Offer:
  - LaTeX Typesetting: Complete composition of mathematics, physics, chemistry, engineering, and computer science content.
  - MathType and Word Equation Editing: Clean-up and conversion of equations in Word documents.
  - MathML Creation and Conversion: LaTeX, MathType, and image-based equations converted to MathML.
  - Image-to-Math Conversion: Equations that exist only as pictures rebuilt as editable, accessible math.
  - Chemical Structures and Formulae: Accurate setting of chemical equations and structures.
  - Equation Numbering and Cross-References: Consistent numbering, linking, and referencing.
  - Web-Ready Math: Equations prepared for display with MathJax or native browser support.
  - Accessible Math for EPUB 3: MathML with descriptive alternatives so screen readers can read equations correctly.
  - Accessible Math in PDF: Tagged math with alternative text for PDF/UA compliance.
  - Math QA: Independent checking of every equation against the source.
Our Process:
  - 1. Source Review: We check your files, formats, and notation conventions.
  - 2. Conversion or Typesetting: Equations are typeset or converted to the target format.
  - 3. Equation Verification: Every equation is compared against the original.
  - 4. Accessibility Testing: Checked with screen readers and math-capable tools.
  - 5. Delivery: Final files with a quality summary.
Target Audience / Who It's For:
Publishers, universities, enterprises, and content creators.

documents.title: OCR and Digitization
documents.summary: Convert print books, journals, and archives into searchable, editable, accessible digital content with Velvora's OCR and digitization services.
documents.content:
OCR and Digitization (OCR and Digitization: Bring Your Print Content Into the Digital World)
Overview: Print archives hold valuable knowledge, but they are hard to search, share, and preserve. Velvora digitizes and converts printed and scanned content into accurate, structured, and accessible digital files. We also convert old or inaccessible digital files into modern formats.
What We Offer:
  - Scanning and Image Capture: High-quality scanning of books, journals, and documents.
  - OCR (Optical Character Recognition): Text recognition from scanned pages and image PDFs.
  - OCR Correction and Proofreading: Human review to fix recognition errors and reach high accuracy.
  - Searchable PDF Creation: Scanned documents turned into searchable PDFs.
  - Conversion to XML, EPUB and HTML: Structured digital output from legacy content.
  - Layout Recreation: Rebuilding the layout, tables, and figures of the original.
  - Archive Digitization: Old journals, newspapers, theses, manuals, and manuscripts.
  - Data Capture and Data Entry: Extraction of data from forms, tables, and documents.
  - Back-Catalogue Conversion: Large-scale conversion of publishing backlists.
  - Accessible Output: Tagged PDFs and EPUBs created from digitized content.
Our Process:
  - 1. Assess: We review sample pages, condition, and target outputs.
  - 2. Capture: Scanning or preparing existing images.
  - 3. Recognize: OCR with specialized tools.
  - 4. Correct: Manual proofreading and structural tagging.
  - 5. Validate: Quality sampling and format checks.
  - 6. Deliver: Final files with a quality report.
Target Audience / Who It's For:
Publishers, universities, enterprises, and content creators.

faqs.q: How many branches or offices does Velvora Solutions have?
faqs.a: Velvora Solutions operates from two verified physical offices in Tamil Nadu, India: our Head Office & Operations Center in Cuddalore (Pathirikuppam) and our Branch Office in Chennai (Porur). Digital delivery and client collaboration are provided to organizations worldwide.

faqs.q: Who is the founder and leader of Velvora Solutions?
faqs.a: Velvora Solutions is founded and led by Iyshwariya Senthil (Founder & Managing Director). With over 7 years of executive experience in publishing operations, universal design, and WCAG accessibility standards, she directs Velvora’s strategic roadmap.

faqs.q: What services does Velvora Solutions provide?
faqs.a: Velvora Solutions provides 5 core pillars of services: Digital Accessibility (WCAG 2.2, PDF/UA, Section 508), ePublishing & Typesetting (EPUB 3, InDesign, LaTeX, MathML), XML Conversion (JATS, BITS, DocBook), AI Automation & IDP, Software Engineering (Web, React, Python/FastAPI), and Data Analytics.

faqs.q: How do I submit my resume or apply for jobs?
faqs.a: Visit our Careers page (/careers), choose an open position or "General Open Application", and upload your resume in PDF, DOC, or DOCX format (up to 10MB). Our recruitment team reviews submissions and responds within 24–48 hours.

faqs.q: What is the turnaround time or deadline for a project?
faqs.a: Project delivery timelines depend on project scope, volume, schema complexity (e.g. JATS XML vs PDF/UA), and client review cycles. Share your specifications with info@velvorasolutions.com for an accurate timeline and quotation.
